title: Scaling one register by a loop
statement: Let a register program $A$ have distinct source and destination registers. At state $test$ it branches to $done$ if the source is zero and otherwise to $down$; at $down$ it decrements the source and enters $inc(0)$. For every $i<factor$, state $inc(i)$ increments the destination and enters $inc(i+1)$, and $inc(factor)=test$. If every initial register value is at most $B$ and the initial destination value plus $factor$ times the initial source value is at most $B$, then from the configuration at $test$ the program can reach $done$ with the source set to zero and the destination increased by $factor$ times the initial source value. Throughout the configurations before the final one, the precondition invariant holds and every register value is at most $B$.
